subject: Champion brief: risk mitigation & procurement runway
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Johnson <aisha.j@finora.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: Champion brief: risk mitigation & procurement runway

Aisha — thanks again for a great discovery call today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed set of next steps so we can keep momentum with the economic + procurement stakeholders you mentioned.

Key takeaways (as I heard them)
- Primary decision criteria: latency SLA for inference (<200ms), clear data segregation, and predictable monthly unit cost.
- Use case: 2 production inference endpoints for document processing pipelines, ramping from ~50k to 300k tokens/mo over Q1.
- Stakeholders: you (champion), Derek (procurement), Priya (security), and a product SME who will own success metrics.

Immediate asks from Finora today
1) Procurement timeline and owners so we can align contract milestones.
2) Security checklist items (what evidence your security team needs).
3) Expected pilot scope (samples, duration, success criteria).

What we'll provide this week
- ROI snapshot tailored to the volumes we discussed (attached: roi-snapshot.xlsx).
- A short security pack and SOC2 summary (I’ll share our security PDF next).
- Draft mutual action plan (MAP) with proposed dates for pilot -> contract.

Suggested next steps
- Aisha: introduce Derek and Priya on an email thread (CC’d them once you confirm).
- Finora: confirm pilot scope (2 endpoints, 2 weeks, traffic pattern) and procurement target date.
- Redwood: we’ll share the security summary and a short internal sell kit for you to use with procurement/legal.

I attached the ROI snapshot and will follow up with the security summary in the next email. If you’d like, Marissa can put together a one-page talk track you can share internally.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

—
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0122
Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Johnson <aisha.j@finora.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Champion brief: risk mitigation & procurement runway

Sean — thanks for the clear recap and the ROI attachment. This aligns well with what I heard on our side. A few notes:  

- Procurement contact: Derek Mills (derek.mills@finora.com) — he’ll own contract cadence and invoice terms.
- Security lead: Priya Shah (cc’d) — she’ll put together the specific evidence checklist we need (SOC2, data retention, key management).
- Procurement timeline: aiming to have vendor selected by EOD Dec 10, so quick pilot in Nov/early Dec would be ideal.

Priya — can you call out any must-have artifacts? Derek — happy to intro you to Sean separately or let us loop in later today.

One ask: Could you send a short security summary and a suggested commercial runway (pilot -> committed) so procurement has numbers to estimate TCO? Also we prefer to see a 60-day pilot with clear exit criteria.

Appreciate it — I’ll wait for your security pack.

Best,
Aisha
Aisha Johnson
Head of ML Platforms, Finora
aisha.j@finora.com

Internal enablement plan (two-pager idea — I’ll produce quickly)
- One-page risk mitigation summary for Priya: SOC2 scope, encryption at-rest/in-transit, KMS integrations, access controls, and audit logs with sample retention windows.
- Procurement-ready commercial runway: 60-day pilot terms, pilot KPIs (latency SLA, error rate, throughput), and a conversion price for committed capacity.
- Champion talk tracks: 3 quick bullets Marissa can hand to Aisha to surface to Derek — 1) predictable unit economics + clear rollback plan, 2) dedicated pilot support and priority routing, 3) legal-friendly data segregation notes.

Neha — can you adapt the ROI sheet for the 60-day pilot and highlight the conversion discount tiers? I’ll draft the one-page talk tracks and attach as finora_talk_tracks.docx.

If useful, we should propose a MAP: pilot sign-off by 11/30, pilot start 12/02, pilot end 01/01, contract execution by 01/15. Adjust if Finora needs faster cadence.

—
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Derek Mills <derek.mills@finora.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Aisha Johnson <aisha.j@finora.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finora.com>, procurement@finora.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Champion brief: risk mitigation & procurement runway

Thanks all — quick procurement checklist from our side so we’re aligned on the gating items.

Must-haves before commercial approval:
- Standard NDAs + MSA review (we’ll expect redlines; please flag any non-negotiable clauses).
- Data handling addendum: confirmation of encryption at-rest and in-transit, and whether Redwood acts as a processor or sub-processor.
- Liability caps and uptime SLA language (we’d prefer a remedy ladder).
- Pricing: estimate for pilot usage and proposed committed discount tiers.

Operational questions:
- Will the pilot require a separate VPC or can we use a dedicated tenancy in Redwood’s environment?
- Expected billing cadence and PO process.

We’d like to see a brief security pack (SOC2 summary, data retention windows, contact for incident response) and a one-page commercial MAP to move through legal quickly. I attached a procurement-checklist.pdf for your reference.

If Redwood can respond with the single-sheet security summary and a MAP by Monday COB, we can get our legal and security folks to triage the request next week.

—
Derek Mills
Senior Procurement Manager, Finora
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Johnson <aisha.j@finora.com>, Derek Mills <derek.mills@finora.com>

Subject: Re: Champion brief: risk mitigation & procurement runway

Derek / Aisha / Priya — thanks for the procurement checklist and timeline. Quick alignment and what we’ll deliver by COB Monday (Nov 23):

What Redwood will deliver
- Security one-sheet (attached: redwood-security-summary.pdf) covering SOC2, KMS options, encryption, and sample audit logs.
- MAP (Mutual Action Plan) one-pager with proposed dates: pilot start 2026-12-02, pilot end 2027-01-01, contract execution target 2027-01-15.
- Pilot commercial terms: 60-day pilot, non-recurring onboarding credit, and a conversion pricing table (see ROI snapshot already shared).
- Answers to tenancy question: we support both dedicated tenancy and VPC peering; we’ll include recommended config options for Finora’s preferred security posture.

Ask of Finora (simple):
1) Confirm pilot scope (2 endpoints, walkthrough traffic sample) so Neha can finalize the ROI numbers.
2) Introduce the legal person handling MSAs or provide their contact for initial redline exchange.

Links and artifacts
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345
- Shared drive pack (security + MAP + ROI): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Finora-Redwood-Pack
- Quickstart guide for pilots: https://docs.redwood.com/secure/finora-quickstart

Next step: Marissa will send the champion talk tracks (one-page) and Neha will circulate the adjusted ROI. If we can get introductions to legal + final pilot scope by Monday, we’ll queue the MAP and SOW draft for Finora review.

Regards,
Sean Gallagher
